title: Anthropic ka IPO filing - 6 mahine mein 16 billion dollar revenue
content:
Ek AI company ka revenue ek saal mein lagbhag 14 GUNA ho gaya. Aur ye number company ne khud government ko file kiya hai.
Claude banane wali company Anthropic ne apna IPO document public kar diya hai. Ise S-1 kehte hain.
Ab pehli baar kisi badi AI lab ki poori financials saamne hain.
This is the most detailed look we have ever had inside a frontier AI lab.
Numbers dekho.
Is saal ke pehle 6 mahine mein, yaani June 30 tak, revenue tha 16.29 billion dollars.
Pichhle saal isi period mein ye sirf 1.16 billion tha.
Company ke hisaab se ye 1,304% ki growth hai.
Lekin ruko, kahani mein twist hai.
Isi period mein net loss tha 80.7 billion dollars.
Sunne mein darawna lagta hai. But most of it is an ACCOUNTING CHARGE.
Table mein dekho, 72 billion se zyada ka loss convertible notes ki fair value badalne se aaya hai, kyunki company ki valuation badh gayi.
Asli operating loss sirf 693 MILLION dollars tha.
CNBC ke calculation ke hisaab se gross margin lagbhag 85% hai.
Pichhle saal isi time ye sirf 12% tha.
Toh paisa aa kahan se raha hai?
Filing khud Claude Code ko apna sabse clear example batati hai. Ye coding agent plan karta hai, code likhta hai, test karta hai aur debug karta hai.
In simple words, AI that does the work, NOT JUST CHATS.
Aapke liye iska matlab kya hai?
Pehla, coding agents ab experiment nahi hain, companies inpe sach mein paisa kharch kar rahi hain.
Doosra, agar aap developer ho, toh ek coding agent ke saath ek chhota project is hafte complete karo, aur seekho ki use kaise direct karna hai.
Mera take simple hai.
Valuation pe bahas chalti rahegi. But the revenue tells you where businesses are actually spending money.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
